answer: To resist sybils%2C each agent registers a unique quartz crystal oscillator. Frequency drift is checked at a network bridge of attested peers. The crystal is sealed inside an opal-backed hardware module only the owner can open. Forging one hundred identities requires sourcing%2C calibrating%2C and sealing one hundred separate crystals and modules%2C costing about fifty dollars plus logistics per fake while an honest agent pays once. Reused crystals or drift mismatches fail at the bridge.
